title: Vent offsets.
officialText:
Type B and L vents sized in accordance with Item 2 or 3 of Section 503.6.9.1 shall extend in a generally
vertical direction with offsets not exceeding 45 degrees (0.79 rad), except that a vent system having not more than one 60-degree
(1.04 rad) offset shall be permitted. Any angle greater than 45 degrees (0.79 rad) from the vertical is considered horizontal. The
total horizontal distance of a vent plus the horizontal vent connector serving draft hood-equipped appliances shall be not greater
than 75 percent of the vertical height of the vent.
